exposure: Reversed flow on the aortic isthmus (AoI)
cohort: 148 singleton pregnancies diagnosed with late-onset FGR (diagnosis ≥32+0 weeks)
finding: There were no significant differences in perinatal outcomes, including vaginal delivery rates and cesarean section rates, between fetuses with late-onset FGR and mild Doppler alterations who had anterograde versus reversed AoI flow.
